response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure experience with relevant exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools. While his direct GenAI/RAG experience is limited, his technical leadership, cloud platform familiarity, and open-source contributions suggest adaptability for the role. The candidate’s staff-level tenure and mentorship align with seniority requirements, though deeper GenAI-specific achievements would strengthen fit.
strengths: Proven technical leadership as a Staff Software Engineer, including AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling at re:cinq.
Extensive cloud platform experience (AWS, Kubernetes) and full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, Python-adjacent tools).
Strong open-source contributions and mentorship, indicating collaboration and engineering excellence.
concerns: Limited explicit GenAI/RAG experience; most AI work appears peripheral (e.g., agentic workflows at re:cinq).
No advanced degree in AI/CS (holds a BS in CS and a fine arts degree), though this is a preferred qualification.
Diverse but fragmented project history may dilute focus on core GenAI/cloud responsibilities.
